shopsMsg2: We will connect you with customers
joinQ1: Why should I become a dekitabi partner?
joinA1: dekitabi is a Japan-based startup company focused solely on Japan. In addition to having the best fees, we aim to work closely with our partners to promote their activities in our app and social media to offer the best to travelers visiting Japan.
joinQ2: Do I need a website to partner with dekitabi?
joinA2: No. Once you create an account with us, you can customize your profile to promote your activities, update their availability, and receive payments through our platform.
accountQ2: Can I have an account without needing to update my availability?
accountA2: Yes! Once your activity page is created, you can choose whether or not to display the availability of your activities. If you choose not to, you'll receive an email asking you to confirm each reservation within 24 hours. The customer will only be charged after you confirm the booking.
accountQ1: What do I need to create an account?
accountA1: Creating an account is easy! Just click the 'Join Us' button and sign up with your email. Then, simply add your shop and activity details so customers can learn more about what you offer!
accountQ3: Is there a fee to create an account?
accountA3: There’s no fee to create an account. The only charge is an 8% fee on confirmed reservations.
paymentA1: Shops that choose to receive payments through our website will be required to continue their registration with Stripe (our payment system). The day after the activity date, the activity amount will be automatically transferred to the shop's balance in their dekitabi account.
paymentA2: Shops that choose to receive payments through our website will have their balance transferred to their bank account every Friday (Tokyo time). Shops that prefer to receive payments on-site will be required to transfer the 8% service fee to our bank account. The bank details and transfer date will be discussed directly via email.
paymentQ3: Which currency will I receive my balance in?
paymentA3: You will receive your balance in Japanese Yen.
